name: NVIDIA Quantum-X800 Q3400-RA XDR InfiniBand switch (leaf)
description: 4U air-cooled XDR InfiniBand switch, 144 x 800 Gb/s over 72 OSFP cages, 115.2 Tb/s. Used as both leaf and spine in two-level fat trees (up to 10,368 NICs); this entry is the leaf role. AC PSUs (8, 200-240 V).

hop_latency_ns.note: NVIDIA does not publish a port-to-port latency for Quantum-X800. Estimated from the previous-generation QM8700 HDR brief ('sub-130ns port-to-port latency', source nvidia-qm8700-brief) and an integrator blog claiming sub-100 ns for Quantum-X800 (introl-x800, unverified). Range widened upward because the 4U system is built from multiple Quantum-3 ASICs (the 2U Q3200 is '2 independent 28.8Tb/s switches') and the internal path is not published.

power_w.note: typical with passive cables (ATIS); excludes optics
